summary.text: Randy Quinn is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 75 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired pastor and U.S. Navy veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that water management, mental health services and quality-of-life infrastructure are his primary policy concerns.

paragraphs.text: Randy Quinn earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 1978 and graduated from the Garrett-Evangelical Theological Seminary in 1987.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Navy from 1987 to 2010 and worked as a pastor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served as a submarine sailor and then as a Navy reserve chaplain for a total of 31 years, and that he served mostly progressive rural congregations as a pastor.
He said he has become involved in his community through church, Kiwanis and politics.

Quinn said in the survey that raising a daughter with special needs showed him the need for special education advocates, and that the legislature must fund public education as the Kansas constitution requires.
